notes.title: About Future Updates
notes.notes: [p]Dear players,[/p][p]Thank you all for your continued support and for being part of our journey![/p][p]At this stage, the game has reached a level that I personally consider satisfactory. Therefore, we [b]will no longer provide regular content updates[/b]. However, if there are [b]serious bugs[/b] or [b]extremely important and reasonable requests from players[/b], we will still carry out necessary maintenance and fixes.[/p][p]While the game may not be perfect, I hope you can understand this decision and continue to enjoy the game.[/p][p]Thank you for your support along the way![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333169/7d372c94a3984486add9cac6f0913eaaa3c1662b.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 👑 Update Announcement | Twelve New Achievements & Save System Improvements
notes.notes:
[p]Dear Kings,[/p][p]Some players mentioned in reviews: “It would be great if every ending had an achievement.”
Well… you’re right, so I made it happen.[/p][h3]🏆 New Achievements[/h3][p]A unique achievement has been prepared for [b]all twelve endings[/b].[/p][p]Whether you end up on the chopping block or as a gloriously flashy puppet king (ahem), you can now unlock your very own “souvenir.”[/p][h3]💾 Save System Improvements[/h3][p]We fixed the previously misbehaving save logic.[/p][p]The save system also got a little more diligent:[/p][list][*][p][b]Before:[/b] Only saved at special event cycles.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Now:[/b] Saves [b]every turn[/b], so your kingdom won’t “forget its history.”[/p][/*][/list][p]👑 Happy ruling![/p]
